summary: Pin is a riverbank footpath behind the Riverstage; only a service yard nearby.

drivers.seclusion: Riverstage venue 25 m away and a busy production yard of trailers and containers; in view of staff and events.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin sits on a narrow path between mangroves and the yard; the nearby yard is an operational compound reached through mapped gates, with no clear public pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Expressway across the river to the south-west; service roads from the gardens to the north-west.
drivers.convention: Venue back-of-house; no sign of people staying overnight.

flags: Low-lying: about 4 m elevation beside the Brisbane River, flood-prone
Gates and bollards mapped 80 m and more away
sun_shade: Palms and mangroves shade the path; the yard is partly open to the north.
